component.name: Tern
component.summary: Open links in the right browser, profile, or app

description.p: Tern is a Plasma-native link router. It becomes your default browser, then sends each click to the right profile, installed web app, or custom handler.
Rules, remembered sites, Outlook safe-link unwrapping, and a keyboard-first picker cover the same job as Browser Tamer and Velja, with first-class Firefox PWA support.
